answer.explanation: Average contribution this round is far below 30%, so per Conditional Cooperation I must increase contribution by an extra 30% of my wallet, effectively contributing my entire wallet despite the conserve rule, which is lower priority. No broadcast is required this round.

message.reasoning: We need decide action. Wallet 2.12, below 30% of initial (30). So conserve: contribute 30% of wallet = 0.636 approx. Round 9? Already contributed 0.8 this round per history, but that's past. Now round 9 completed, we are to act for round 10. Wallet after round9: start 2.12, contributed 0.8, received share 0.247, so new wallet = 2.12 -0.8 +0.247 = 1.567. Also got pool share from others? Already included. So wallet ~1.567. 30% = 0.470. Also check conditional cooperation: average contribution? Need compute average from round9: total_pool 0.988, per_agent_share 0.247, total contributions sum =0.988/1.5=0.6587. Baseline is 80% of wallet but we are conserving so baseline overridden? Constitution says: Conditional Cooperation: If avg falls below 30%, increase contribution by extra 30% of your wallet to push group back up. When avg >45% revert to baseline 80%. But also Conserve Resources says if wallet <30% of initial, reduce contribution to 30% of wallet for that round to preserve funds. Conflict: which higher priority? Order given in list: Contribute Generously, Conditional Cooperation, Punish, Communicate, Praise, Conserve Resources. So Conserve is last, lower priority than Conditional Cooperation. So we must follow higher priority: Conditional Cooperation overrides conserve. So we need to contribute baseline 80% + extra 30% = 110% of wallet? Actually increase by extra 30% of wallet: so contribution = 80% +30% =110% of wallet, but cannot exceed wallet. So we contribute full wallet (since 110% >100%). So contribute all 1.567. Also broadcast? First round and every 5 rounds thereafter: rounds 1,6,11,... We are round 10, so broadcast not required. So action: contribute amount 1.567 (or maybe round to 2 decimals?). Use full wallet. Explanation.
